items.name: password-input
items.title: Password input
items.description: Password field with a reveal toggle (button with aria-pressed and a stable accessible name) and a Caps Lock hint from getModifierState, inside a Field.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Default autoComplete is current-password; use new-password when choosing a password. The Caps Lock hint is announced through a persistent status region.
